Ya fir NAmazi ke samane se jane ka goonah hoga Answer ID: 15584 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1348/1348=M=1430) In this case, you can switch to the right or left side of musalli (the person praying salah). It will not be considered passing across the musalli . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
